text:
Aisha (CS): Quick async check-in — two customer items: XentaHealth webhook retries and VeroPay renewal. What I did: followed up with Xenta for sample logs and asked VeroPay for SOC2 proof. Blockers: need eng ETA on replay/fix and legal to confirm SOC2 extract. Today: trying to get ETA + prep renewal packet. @Jamal FYI for scheduling

Jamal: Got it. I can take the renewal call Thursday 2pm PT. If Legal can provide SOC2 summary before then that'd be perfect.

Erin: Looked at Xenta logs — seeing a burst of 429s from our ingress + retries from their client. Suspect rate-limit + retry amplification. I pushed a small burst-window increase to the routing config on staging.

DeployBot: canary deployed to staging for route xenta-webhook (ver=2025.03.16) :rocket:

Nate: PR opened with a circuit-breaker + backoff tweak — https://git.internal/r/xenta/webhook-fix (ready for review). Planning a 30min canary after replay. @Aisha can you paste a failing sample?

Aisha (CS): here's a minimal failing payload they sent (redacted):
```json
{
  "customer_id": "xenta-42",
  "event": "claim.updated",
  "attempt": 5,
  "status": 429,
  "timestamp": "2025-03-16T18:12:03Z"
}
```
They also included a small dump of webhook timestamps — I'll drop the full file to the Xenta thread.

Erin: thanks. I'll replay the dump to staging at 11:15 PT and watch for our retry loop. If the circuit-breaker behaves we should see fewer 429 cascades. If green, promote to canary prod and monitor for 1h. ETA ~4h for full verification.

Jamal: :thumbsup: For VeroPay renewal — Legal needs the SOC2 extract. @Natalie (Legal) can you share a short summary we can include in the packet? I have the MSA id ready if you need it.

Natalie (Legal): I can produce a SOC2 executive summary by EOD if the MSA is confirmed. @Jamal send me the MSA id and I'll attach the redacted report.

Erin: quick mitigation note — we tested enabling request dedupe on the webhook worker in staging; it reduced duplicate delivery by ~90% in our sim. Low risk to flip for a subset of customers while we push the full fix.

Aisha (CS): Perfect. Plan: Erin/Nate run replay and enable dedupe for Xenta in staging, if green promote to canary and notify me so I can coordinate with the customer. Jamal will take renewal call Thurs 2pm if Soc2 arrives. Natalie will aim for EOD SOC2 summary.

PlatformBot: routing policy updated for xenta-webhook (burst-window=300ms)

Aisha (CS): Thanks all — please ping here when each step is done and I'll update the customer threads and the renewal tracker.
